state.seed_assertion: Loose or contaminated connectors, soldering defects, and wire crimping issues are among the most common causes of intermittent faults.

sentences.1: Loose or contaminated connectors, soldering defects, and wire crimping issues are among the most common causes of intermittent faults.
sentences.2: Interconnections at various levels are the most common cause of the faults I see: loose or contaminated connectors, soldering, wire crimping, etc.
sentences.3: Loose conductors, damaged flex cables and marginal sensors can produce pulses too short to notice on an HMI.
sentences.4: Loose conductors, damaged flex cables and marginal sensors can produce pulses too short to notice on an HMI.
sentences.5: Loose terminals and oxidized connections create jitter that a PLC processor might interpret as a false state, undermining signal integrity.
sentences.6: Loose terminals and oxidized connections are silent killers of signal integrity.
